sections.theory:
Exercise questions

1. Choose and write the suitable answers.

i The angle of the sector of the discus throw is ________ degrees.

(a) 34.92  (b) 40.0  (c) 35  (d) 35.92

ii The inner diameter of the circle of the discus throw is ________ metres.

(a) 2.50  (b) 1.50  (c) 3.50  (d) 1.75

iii In the discus throw, if there are fewer than eight players, then ________ turns are given.

(a) 3  (b) 2  (c) 1  (d) 6

iv The discus falling outside the sector is ________ .

(a) a mistake  (b) a repeat turn  (c) disqualification  (d) correct

v In the discus throw there are ________ ways of gripping the discus.

(a) one  (b) two  (c) three  (d) four

vi For the 1500-metre race there are no regular ________ .

(a) ground  (b) rules  (c) lanes  (d) uniform

vii The 1500-metre race is run on a ________ -metre standard track.

(a) 200  (b) 400  (c) 600  (d) 800

2. Write the answers to the following questions.

i Make the sector of the discus and record the fouls.

ii Record the rules of the discus throw.

iii Make a score sheet for finding the positions of 6 players in the discus throw.

iv State the rules and fouls of the 1500-metre race.

vi 1500 میٹر دوڑ کے لیے باقاعدہ ________ نہیں ہوتیں۔

(a) گراؤنڈ  (b) قوانین  (c) گلیاں  (d) یونیفارم

۲۔ درج ذیل سوالات کے جوابات لکھیں۔

iv 1500 میٹر دوڑ کے قوانین اور فاؤلز بیان کریں۔
